answer: Agent economies can resist Sybil attacks via Proof-of-Spacetime commitments. Each agent seals unique data sectors with slow encoding bound to its key and answers timed Merkle challenges to prove persistent disk retention. This ongoing river of audits forces attackers to dedicate physical storage capacity and I/O per identity, whether in a velvet studio or a shale vault. However, cheap bulk hard drives still let large datacenter operators scale many fake nodes.
